narr: Enough moisture remained over northern Arizona for a few strong thunderstorms. One of those storms caused flash flooding in the northeast part of the state.
ev: Flooding was reported about two miles west of Jeddito at the intersection of State Route 264 and BIA-9101.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLOOD REPORT FROM 2 W JEDDITO. FLOODING ON ROADWAY REPORTED AT BIA-9101 AND SR-264.
